system.description:
He doesn't kill. He ruins.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Advantage on Deception checks. When a creature fails a save against your spell, they take -1 to their next save (stacks to -3).
  • Patron's Mark (4th): Once per day, plant a damaging rumour about a creature in the mind of one person within 60ft (Will save against your Class Save DC, to resist). On a failed save they believe they heard it from a trusted source and will repeat it.
  • Patron Feature (8th): Once per day, corrupt one creature's strongest loyalty (Will save against your Class Save DC) — on a failed save they act against their deepest allegiance once before realising what happened.

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Baalzebul in the World of Arneyan wiki.
